operational_note: The mission ran its own orchestrator on a free-tier route (openrouter/minimax/minimax-m3.1-flash:free) and delegated three research lanes. Two lanes (gpt-6-luna, gemini-3.8-flash) died on provider quota exhaustion; only the flash-lite lane completed. Total priced worker inference for the whole mission was 0.1947 USD. This is itself a data point for the report: the quota-bounded cheap tier is a single point of failure, and the fallback route must exist and be authorised in advance.
